bullets: Genomic Findings & Carrier Context: Priority findings include single-copy recessive carrier status in TAT (Tyrosinemia type II, heterozygous carrier), ATM (Hereditary cancer-predisposing syndrome, heterozygous carrier), AMPD1 (Muscle AMP deaminase deficiency, heterozygous carrier) (where the intact second gene copy maintains normal baseline function) alongside actionable pathway/susceptibility findings in POLG (Spinocerebellar ataxia with epilepsy, heterozygous), VDR (Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, heterozygous), MC1R (Skin and Hair Hypopigmentation, heterozygous).

Actionable Medication Safety (CPIC / FDA): Key prescribing precautions are identified — avoid or select alternatives for POLG (Valproic Acid, Sodium Valproate, Divalproex Sodium), CYP2C19 (Clopidogrel (Plavix)); and adjust starting doses or monitor VKORC1 (Warfarin (Coumadin)), ABCG2 (Antineoplastic Agents, Apixaban, Dolutegravir, Felodipine, Iguratimod, Sorafenib (+3 more)).

Preventive Care Takeaway: Focus annual primary care discussions on the high-level wellness and screening topics in Section 2; single-copy carrier findings do not require invasive diagnostic procedures.
